optimizedDescription.value: Pure mergeSchemaLayers applies ordered inheritance, plugin, and override operations to SchemaYamlData without mutation.

optimizedContext.value:
# Schema Merge

## Rules

- Export sync pure mergeSchemaLayers(base: SchemaYamlData, layers: readonly SchemaLayer[]): SchemaYamlData from domain/services/merge-schema-layers.ts.
- SchemaLayer: source extends|plugin|override, ref, operations remove/create/prepend/append/set.
- Apply each layer order: remove → create → prepend → append → set; layer order: root-to-parent extends, declared schemaPlugins, one schemaOverrides.
- Identities: artifacts id; workflow step; hooks/validations/deltaValidations/rules/preHashCleanup id; metadataExtraction rules/constraints/scenarios/context id. Nested targets identify parent then child.
- remove deletes identity; null clears optional scalar; absent/required target throws SchemaValidationError. create/prepend/append reject collisions, preserve declaration order. set scalars last-writer-wins; replaces existing array entry in-place; absent target throws SchemaValidationError.
- Targets mirror top scalars, artifacts, workflow, nested arrays. Post-merge reject duplicate identities and dangling artifact.requires; errors identify layer and operation. Return new data; never mutate inputs.

## Constraints

- No I/O, fs, yaml, zod; no application/, infrastructure/, composition/ imports.
- Operates intermediate SchemaYamlData below entities/buildSchema.
